mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, name, email, user_type, status, temp_pwd_flag, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, GROUP_CONCAT(ur.role_id ORDER BY ur.role_id SEPARATOR ',') AS roleIds, GROUP_CONCAT(r.name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS roleNames, CASE WHEN COUNT(ur.role_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS assigned FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM users u
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
